verdict.rationale: ANEF is a French government portal for foreign nationals, so documented non-resident guidance (eligibility, accepted foreign credentials or identifiers, extra steps) is a fair question for it. The probes show only that the front door returns a ~3 KB JavaScript shell with almost no readable text, and that the parent ministry site blocks agents with a Cloudflare 403. Neither probe surfaces any eligibility, credential or procedural guidance on the service's own pages, so the verdict is "none".
